title: 14 Segment Display
body:
"Allows you to display numbers and letters. Bottom middle input allows you to provide a number input to display. Bottom left input allows you to provide a color. Top middle output is a passthrough for the number input. Optionally, you can individually activate every segment."

The 14 Segment Display is a structure that can be purchased from Alan's AutoLogistics. It accepts logic signals to light up sections of its display.

Functionality

The 14 Segment Display has fourteen inputs on the back which can be activated individually to light up the corresponding segment, with a brightness ranging from a signal of 0 (unlit) to 10 (maximum brightness). There are also two extra inputs on the bottom which accept larger signals. The input to the side changes the color of the display. The input in the middle accepts signals from 0 to 36, lighting up parts of the matrix with a brightness equivalent to receiving a signal of 7. Signals up to 10 function identically to the 7 Segment Display, where 0 displays nothing, 1-9 are their respective numbers, and 10 displays 0. However, the 14 Segment Display can display capital Latin characters, which are alphabetically ordered from 11 to 36. The table below functions as a quick reference for each character.
